sloka: सुग्रीवेण एवम् उक्ते तु हनुमान् हरि पुंगवः ।उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानर मंत्रिणाम् ॥४-३२-९॥
transliteration: sugrīveṇa evam ukte tu hanumān hari puṁgavaḥ ।uvāca svena tarkeṇa madhye vānara maṁtriṇām ॥4-32-9॥

translations.english: When Sugriva spoke thus, Hanuman the great monkey, submitted in the presnce of the monkeyministers, applying his own logic:
